network_operator: SP Energy Networks / SP Transmission (site adjoins ScottishPower transmission infrastructure)
nearby_substation: Cockenzie substation (ScottishPower); new Inch Cape Offshore Wind onshore substation on ~7 acres of the western portion of the former power station site (operational from autumn 2025)
evidence_basis: No connection application, offer or MW figure has been published for the data centre. The site's grid advantage is inferred from its history as a ~1,200 MW coal power station with legacy transmission connection and from SDCL commissioning advisors to assess 'availability of power' as part of pre-site due diligence (council statement, June 2026).
notes: Cockenzie power station (operated 1967/68-2013) gave the site an established high-voltage grid node; the Inch Cape offshore wind connection and consented substation works reinforce the location's transmission access. Whether and how the data centre would connect has not been disclosed.
